title: Yellow Molten Ethiopian Beef Kitfo
description: A traditional Ethiopian dish featuring grilled beef, dried cherries, and a spicy mustard sauce, served in a molten and indulgent form, kitfo style.
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high heat.
In a large bowl, mix together the chopped beef, dried cherries, mustard, garlic, ginger, mitmita spice, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Divide the mixture into 4 equal parts and shape each part into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a patty.
Grill the patties for 4 minutes per side, or until they reach an internal temperature of 130 degrees.
Remove the patties from the grill and let them rest for 5 minutes.
Serve the kitfo immediately, while still molten and juicy.
Traditionally, kitfo is served with a side of injera bread or vegetables.
Garnish with additional dried cherries and mitmita spice, if desired.
